summary: The publish decision's own row declaration and attempt marker (cinatra#4150). Four columns. (1) agent_run_publish_decisions.declared_rows text, JSON-as-text like surfaced_values: the rows ([{ label, input }]) the template declared for the decision's node when the run parked there, written by insertParkedDecision at the park. The publish card draws a decision's rows from it, so a later recompile that changes agent_templates.publish_rows never relabels a decision already surfaced; null = not recorded, and the card then falls back to the template's current rows. (2) agent_runs.reset_generation integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0: a retry's reset (failed -> pending_input) raises it by 1 in its compare-and-set; every existing run reads 0. (3) agent_run_publish_decisions.run_generation integer, nullable: the run's reset_generation at the park; a decision belongs to the run's current attempt only while the two are equal, so a closed decision of an earlier attempt never holds a later attempt; null = a row written by older code, read as generation 0. (4) agent_runs.dispatch_publish_rows text: the publish rows map of the template object the worker dispatched the run's current attempt with, written by the queued -> running CAS, from which the park copies its node's rows; null = not recorded. BACKFILL of run_generation, rows still NULL only: the run's reset_generation when the run exists, is not in pending_input, and its current attempt started no later than the decision (started_at IS NULL or created_at >= started_at); else -1 (an attempt a reset ended). No other stored value changes. Marked destructive because the convention counts a NOT NULL column added to an existing table and a backfill as user-land-affecting (the core__0126 precedent); no stored value is lost. up runs outside a transaction with lock_timeout 5 s (set first, reset last) around the column adds, so an ALTER queued behind a long reader fails (55P03) and replays instead of stalling the table; each add is catalog-only (nullable, or a constant default). Idempotent: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, and the backfill touches only NULL rows. Twin of the fresh-install bootstrap DDL (publishDecisionSchemaQueries in src/lib/artifacts/publication-operation-schema.ts, and the dispatch_publish_rows and reset_generation lines in src/lib/drizzle-store.ts), shipped in the SAME change. down() drops the four columns and what they hold. SEQ IS PROVISIONAL: 0132 is the highest sequence on main (2026-11-23); a rename-only renumber at merge is normal.
